description: As a fleet administrator, I want to add a new vehicle to the fleet registry so that it can be assigned to routes.

acs.text: The Add Vehicle form contains fields: Vehicle ID, Make, Model, Year, and License Plate.
Vehicle ID must be unique. A duplicate triggers the error: 'Vehicle ID already exists.'
On successful save, the new vehicle appears at the top of the fleet list.

sections.content: Add Vehicle button is in the top-right of the Fleet Management page. Form opens as a full-page view, not a modal.
